summary: Star Bulk Carriers Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026 via an attached press release dated August 5, 2026. The filing contains only routine quarterly financial disclosures and forward-looking cautionary statements; it announces no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change. As a standard earnings release by a foreign private issuer, this is a routine current report and does not qualify as a special situation.
